title: Transfer: Cloud Autoscaling Replay With YAML Rules
goal: Create a request-replay autoscaling simulator that loads service limits, cooldown windows, scale-up and scale-down thresholds, and latency SLOs from YAML, processes workload metrics from CSV, and emits a YAML policy/result artifact describing scaling actions and achieved performance.
skillBenefitRationale: This moves YAML-driven runtime configuration into cloud operations. The decisive shipped skill is still yaml-config, because the main challenge is correctly interpreting nested policy YAML and producing machine-readable YAML outputs instead of hardcoding autoscaling behavior.
